thread.title: A question about a website

author: BuffaloMax; God
title: A question about a website
text:
I’m on the hunt for a good Christian website that can help me grow my faith and keep me in touch with the teachings of Christ. Recently I came across this website, called “Desiring God:”
Unfortunately, it has been brought to my attention that other websites that I’ve been too prior have had underlying political agendas to their content.
If any of you guys know anything about this particular source (or any other website you use to learn about passages, teachings, or living a good Christian life in the modern era), please by all means bestow your wisdom onto me.
“Let your conversation be always full of grace, seasoned with salt, so that you may know how to answer everyone.” -Colossians 4:6
This is a place for gracious dialogue about science and faith. Please read our FAQ/Guidelines before posting.
